violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: THERMOMETER MISSING IN #7 1 DR UC, THERMOMETER BROKEN #6 2 DR UC BAKERY.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM PLACED NEW THERMOMETER IN BOTH UNITS. PANERA BREAD #1175 (Inspection Date: 05/06/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: OBSERVED PLUMBING CONNECTIONS UNDER HAND SINK NEXT TO DISH MACHINE LEAKING WHEN HOT WATER VALVE IN ON POSITION.
violations.corrective_action: REPAIR HOT WATER VALVE AND PLUMBING PIPING.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution.
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. FACILITY TO USE DISHWASHER AND SUBMERGE EQUIPMENT IN SANITIZER AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK BEFORE AIR DRYING.
